detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic, live-action cinematic short with natural lighting, true-to-life skin texture and hair detail, and restrained realistic performances; the tone is cold, tense, and emotionally stark. No subtitles, no background music, no on-screen text.
[Shot 1] A wide shot inside <Picture 3>, the hospital ward with white linens, IV drip stands, the "12" bed number sign, and a window with a city view letting in soft natural daylight. <Subject 1> 林素 — long straight black hair, gold hoop earrings, fitted trench coat, high heels — enters the frame walking briskly with efficient, businesslike strides. The camera tracks alongside her movement, following her across the ward, then settles as she stops beside the bed and stands over it, looking down from a position of superiority. Her heels strike the floor with crisp "哒、哒" clicks echoing slightly in the quiet room. No dialogue.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a static medium shot in the same ward. <Subject 2> 赵玉芬 — the heavyset elderly woman with short curly gray hair in her dark-red floral pajama top — lies in the hospital bed, pushing her body slightly forward with both hands braced on the bed rail, her expression anxious and desperate as she looks up toward 林素 at the frame edge. She pleads in a sharp, harsh, rapid elderly female voice, <d>[Chinese] 素素！妈快死了，快帮妈交两万手术费！</d> Beneath the line, the ECG monitor beeps steadily, "滴滴、滴滴".
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1> 林素's face. Her expression is blank, eyes cold and fixed forward; the camera pushes in slowly toward her face across the shot. Her lips part and she speaks in a calm, clear, detached adult female voice, <d>[Chinese] 赵女士，我们没有任何法律关系。</d> The ambient room tone is low and quiet, emphasizing the coldness of the delivery. The video ends on her unchanging, cold gaze.
